name: kepler-gl
description: Create interactive map visualizations and export to standalone HTML using the keplergl Python package. Use when the user wants to create maps, visualize geospatial data, plot locations on a map, or generate HTML map files from DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, GeoJSON, or CSV data.

interface.shortDescription: Create kepler.gl maps from DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, GeoJSON, or CSV and export standalone HTML.
capabilities: generate HTML map files with the keplergl Python package
